kbne01.title: Gemini replied in three minutes
kbne01.caption:
Breaking: a Gemini replied in three minutes and the newsroom had to sit down.
No games, no waiting, just interest. Who's the fastest replier in your chat?

kbne02.title: Virgo kept the typo
kbne02.caption:
A Virgo sent "tmorrow" and did not fix it. We are calling it a historic night.
The crush did not care. Tag the friend who edits every text.

kbne03.title: Scorpio went first
kbne03.caption:
Scorpio said "I miss you" first. No riddle, no subtext, no hidden meaning detected.
The reply came right back. Which sign do you think says it first?

kbne04.title: Taurus left the usual spot
kbne04.caption:
Sky cam confirms a Taurus walked two whole blocks to try somewhere new.
They ordered the usual. But here. What's your sign's "usual"?

kbne05.title: Leo asked a follow-up question
kbne05.caption:
Replay shows a Leo listening, then asking more, then asking about the dog's name.
The spotlight looks good on two. Who asks the best questions on a date?

kbne06.title: Cancer archived the old chat
kbne06.caption:
2 a.m., the old chat, again. Then Cancer hit archive, not delete, and said yes to breakfast.
The memories are safe. So are they.

kbne07.title: Capricorn's out-of-office is on
kbne07.caption:
Friday, 5:00 p.m.: a Capricorn closed the laptop and markets reacted.
Then they texted "free this weekend?" Which sign needs an out-of-office for feelings?

kbne08.title: Aquarius said the word
kbne08.caption:
Rewind it. Slow it down. An Aquarius said "feelings" out loud, on purpose.
The warmth gauge broke a record. Did your Aquarius ever say it first?

kbne09.title: Sagittarius booked a second date
kbne09.caption:
Last spring: "let's see where the wind takes us." Tonight: Saturday, 7 p.m., table 4.
The wind took them to a reservation. Plans look good on you, Sag.

kbne10.title: Libra picked the restaurant
kbne10.caption:
"Where should we eat?" A Libra picked in under ten seconds and the group chat lost it.
Noodles at 7. Who in your friend group always decides?

kbne11.title: Aries waited
kbne11.caption:
One text sent. No reply. An Aries did push-ups, a lap and some breathing instead of double texting.
The reply came. Patience is also bold.

kbne12.title: Pisces hasn't cried
kbne12.caption:
Ninety minutes, zero tears. The newsroom held its breath.
Then a tiny dog in a scarf showed up in the credits. Who else would've lasted longer?

kbne13.title: The group chat went silent
kbne13.caption:
Eleven reads, zero replies. Turns out everyone was typing in a different chat.
Code name: cake. Happy birthday, Pisces.

kbne14.title: Situationship enters month six
kbne14.caption:
Month 6 of "just hanging out" and nobody has asked the question.
Then one talk card, face down, and they both said "dating?" at once. Ask the question.
